method: Constructed/replayed contract fixtures executed through SQL validation and the read-only repository; not new LLM generations or benchmark accuracy.

results.sql: SELECT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, commerce.products.category AS category, SUM(commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $1 GROUP BY commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.products.category ORDER BY SUM(commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand) DESC NULLS LAST, commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.products.category LIMIT 200

SELECT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, commerce.products.category AS category, AVG(commerce.inventory.fill_rate) AS fill_rate FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date >= $1 AND commerce.inventory.snapshot_date < $2 GROUP BY commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.products.category ORDER BY commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.products.category LIMIT 200

SELECT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, commerce.inventory.product_id AS product_id, commerce.products.product_name AS product_name, commerce.inventory.stockout_days AS stockout_days FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date >= $1 AND commerce.inventory.snapshot_date < $2 ORDER BY commerce.inventory.stockout_days DESC NULLS LAST, commerce.inventory.snapshot_date, commerce.inventory.product_id, commerce.products.product_name LIMIT 200

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_line_value FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category LIMIT 200

WITH ret AS (SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND r.return_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.product_id), ord AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS ordered_units FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT ret.product_id, ret.returned_units, ord.ordered_units, CAST(ret.returned_units AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(ord.ordered_units, 0) AS returned_to_ordered_ratio FROM ret JOIN ord ON ret.product_id = ord.product_id ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST, ret.product_id LIMIT 200

WITH ret AS (SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND r.return_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.product_id), ord AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS ordered_units FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT ret.product_id, ret.returned_units, ord.ordered_units, CAST(ret.returned_units AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(ord.ordered_units, 0) AS returned_to_ordered_ratio FROM commerce.products AS p JOIN ret ON p.product_id = ret.product_id JOIN ord ON p.product_id = ord.product_id ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST, ret.product_id LIMIT 200

SELECT i.snapshot_date, i.product_id, p.product_name FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date >= CAST('2022-12-01' AS DATE) AND i.snapshot_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.stockout_flag = TRUE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id AND o.order_date >= CAST('2022-12-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE)) ORDER BY i.product_id LIMIT 200

WITH inv AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.units_sold) AS inventory_units_sold FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date >= CAST('2022-12-01' AS DATE) AND i.snapshot_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category), ord AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS ordered_units FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2022-12-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category) SELECT COALESCE(inv.category, ord.category) AS category, inv.inventory_units_sold, ord.ordered_units FROM inv FULL JOIN ord ON inv.category = ord.category ORDER BY inv.category LIMIT 200
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.n - 1), 0) AS duplicate_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM commerce.inventory AS i GROUP BY i.snapshot_date, i.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS d LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT r.product_id,r.order_id FROM commerce.returns r JOIN commerce.products p ON r.product_id=p.product_id JOIN commerce.orders o ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commerce.order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id=p.product_id AND oi.order_id=o.order_id) LIMIT 200

results.note: Overload-resolution integration probe; not a frozen question score.
